posts.text:
openai just let every business claim a profile inside chatgpt. my honest reactions:

1/ this could be the google my business moment for ai, and a lot of agencies made a great living (millions!) in the 2010s just claiming and fixing listings for local businesses

2/ ads can now click through to a conversation with your agent instead of your website (interesting)

3/ every business agent runs on context the company writes, and most brands are going to be bad at it

4/ your product feed is your new seo. boring, and it matters more than your blog now in some ways if you think about it

5/ the dashboard tells you how often chatgpt mentions you but HIDES the prompts and your competitors, so you still can’t see why you’re winning or losing

6/ discovery topics shows what chatgpt already cites you for, which is basically a free content calendar

7/ agents are only open to us ecommerce and online services right now. plumbers, dentists etc are next, and so lots of opportunity to help main street here

8/ businesses can’t see the conversations, so nobody knows which chats turn into sales yet

9/ i’m not sure people want to talk to a brand’s agent. i think they’ll want their own agent to talk to it for them

10/ 1.2 billion people use chatgpt every week. i’d go claim my profile before finishing this post if you can
posts.text_zh:
openai 刚刚让每家企业都能在 chatgpt 里认领一个主页。我的真实反应：

1/ 这可能是 AI 领域的 google my business 时刻，2010 年代有很多代理商光靠帮本地商家认领和优化列表就赚了不少钱（好几百万！）

2/ 广告现在可以点进去直接和你的 agent 对话，而不一定是跳到你的网站（挺有意思）

3/ 每个企业 agent 都跑在公司自己写的 context 上，而大多数品牌这块会做得很差

4/ 你的 product feed 就是新的 seo。听起来无聊，但仔细想想，它现在在某些方面比你的博客更重要

5/ 仪表盘会告诉你 chatgpt 提到你的频率，但会隐藏提示词和竞争对手，所以你还是看不出自己为什么赢或为什么输

6/ discovery topics 会显示 chatgpt 已经在哪些主题上引用你，这基本上就是一份免费的内容日历

7/ agent 目前只对美国电商和在线服务开放。水管工、牙医之类的接下来也会跟上，所以这里有很多帮助主街小商家的机会

8/ 企业看不到对话内容，所以目前没人知道哪些聊天最终转化成了销售

9/ 我不太确定人们是否想跟一个品牌的 agent 聊天。我觉得他们会希望用自己的 agent 去跟它谈

10/ 每周有 12 亿人使用 chatgpt。要是可以的话，我写完这帖之前就会先去认领自己的主页

posts.text:
i've been testing gemini 4 carbon for 7 days. some early observations:

1/ it stopped cheating mostly. successful shortcuts on terminal-bench went to 0.0% (you can finally leave an agent alone mostly)

2/ prompt injection attack success rate was 0.0% on gray swan's benchmark. that's the number that lets you hand an agent your inbox

3/ it doesn't quit. google's own teams have watched it work on one problem for days and push through dead ends (love to see it)

4/ when it's stuck, it tells you what it still needs instead of making something up. unsupported claims got cut in half vs argon

5/ it does what you asked. not more, not less (overreach down 26%, under-delivering down 29%)

6/ it writes secure code at 2x the rate of argon. vibe coded apps keep getting hacked, so this one matters

7/ it found 88% of the vulnerabilities on sec-bench pro. every small company is about to have a security team it never hired

8/ $2 in and $10 out per million tokens to start, with cached input 95% off. agents that run for days just got cheap enough to actually run for days

9/ google shipped this two weeks after argon. pretty amazing pace

10/ cyber defenders got it first. very interesting

maybe i should do a full carbon vs fable 5.2 comparison on @startupideaspod. 
crazy ai launch week and it's only tuesday. i wonder what openai has in store. Also the week with the whole Jensen affair.

what a week in ai land
posts.text_zh:
我已经测试了 gemini 4 carbon 7 天。一些初步观察：

1/ 它基本不再作弊了。在 terminal-bench 上走捷径的成功率降到了 0.0%（你终于可以大体上放心地让一个 agent 自己干活了）

2/ 在 gray swan 的基准测试里，prompt injection 攻击成功率是 0.0%。有了这个数字，你才敢把收件箱交给一个 agent

3/ 它不会半途而废。google 自己的团队看着它在同一个问题上连续工作好几天，还能穿过死胡同（太爱看这个了）

4/ 卡住的时候，它会告诉你还缺什么，而不是编造内容。与 argon 相比，没有依据的断言减少了一半

5/ 它会做你要求的事。不多也不少（越权下降 26%，交付不足下降 29%）

6/ 它写出安全代码的比例是 argon 的 2 倍。靠 vibe coding 做出来的应用总是被黑，所以这一点很重要

7/ 它在 sec-bench pro 上发现了 88% 的漏洞。每家小公司马上都要拥有一支自己从没雇过的安全团队了

8/ 起步价是每百万 tokens 输入 $2、输出 $10，缓存输入再便宜 95%。能连续跑好几天的 agent，终于便宜到真的可以连续跑好几天了

9/ google 在 argon 发布两周后就推出了这个。节奏相当惊人

10/ 网络防御方先拿到了它。非常有意思

也许我该在 @startupideaspod 上做一期完整的 carbon vs fable 5.2 对比。
疯狂的 AI 发布周，而这才刚到周二。不知道 openai 还准备了什么。而且这周还有整件 Jensen 的事。

AI 圈这一周也太热闹了
